_meta.//: SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR EVERY OTHER LANGUAGE. Every key that exists here must exist in every other file in this directory, with the same placeholders in it - scripts/i18nprobe.ts fails the build otherwise. The English values are also load-bearing in another way: forty browser harnesses select elements by their visible text, so changing a string here is changing a test selector.
_meta.name: English

menu.disclaimer: A personal project - real names used for fun, not for sale.

groups.firstJobs: Before your first match, these three are the job.

wizard.title: New Career
wizard.pickCompetition: Choose the competition you'll manage in.
wizard.needCompetition: Pick a competition to carry on.
wizard.needClub: Pick the club you want to manage.
wizard.needName: Enter your name to carry on.
wizard.allSet: Everything set. One tap from the dugout.
wizard.dreamBlurb: The board sets the season. You set the career - tap the one thing that would make this save worth finishing.

betweenJobs.one: You're between jobs. {n} vacancy open - apply, or press Continue and wait for the right one.
betweenJobs.other: You're between jobs. {n} vacancies open - apply, or press Continue and wait for the right one.

home.hintRest: It moves the week on and brings the next thing to you. Everything else on this screen can wait until you want it.
home.deadlineWeek: 🚨 DEADLINE WEEK: the window slams shut
home.tapSetTeam: Tap to set your team, then press Continue to play.
home.noMatchWeek: No match this week - Continue advances to the next round.
home.testWeek: 🌍 TEST WEEK: this Saturday is your country's. Your assistant minds any club fixture.
home.noTest: No Test on the calendar - the union watches your club work in the meantime.
home.annualSub: Last season on one page - the league, the cups, the stars and the money. Tap to read.

pressSub.one: {n} question awaiting your reply - your answers move morale.
pressSub.other: {n} questions awaiting your reply - your answers move morale.

home.blankSub: No fixture this week. A friendly banks sharpness and combinations for the squad - but injuries in a meaningless game sting twice as much.

squad.whyOut: injured, banned, away or on loan
squad.emptyGameTime: Nobody is short of the minutes he was promised. Tap Everyone Shown to set what the rest of the squad has been told.
squad.emptyFiltered: Nobody matches that. Clear the filters to see the whole squad.
squad.contractsNote: ⏳ runs out this summer · 💼 his camp wants improved terms · red year expiring, amber next summer. Tap a man to open talks.
squad.gameTimeNote: Ap is what he has played, Due is what a man on that promise should have played by now. Tell a squad man he is a Key Player and he will hold you to it.
squad.statusKeyDesc: He starts unless he is injured. Sit him and he wants to know why.
squad.statusRotationDesc: In and out of the side, and he knows it. Roughly every other week.
squad.statusSquadDesc: Cover and a bench shirt. A quarter of the matches keeps him happy.
squad.statusProspectDesc: Learning his trade. A handful of appearances a season is progress.
squad.statusFringeDesc: He has been told where he stands. He expects nothing and may want out.

selection.untouched: Untouched sheet: your assistant named this side, with his eye for it, not yours - and nobody is updating it for form or fitness. Change a shirt and it becomes your team.
selection.pickAnybody: Pick anybody - the shirt takes his position
selection.leadershipSub: the armband, and who takes responsibility for what
selection.leadershipNote: The skipper lifts attack and defence and calms tempers; the vice leads at half effect when he is missing. A portfolio below that does not add strength, it concentrates it: only XV men with real authority carry one, and a real leader can carry more than one.

fixtures.knockoutNoTable: This competition is a knockout, so there is no table to show. Pick a league above.

medical.physioVacant: · post vacant - injuries run their full course (Training → Backroom Staff)
medical.nothingOnHimSub: No player matching that search is injured, suspended, rusty or short of a gallop.
medical.quietRoomSub: Nobody injured, suspended, rusty or running on empty. Enjoy it - it never lasts.
medical.treatmentSub: ruled out - a specialist consult ({fee}) can shorten a long lay-off
medical.redZoneSub: 1,300+ minutes: they break easier and tire faster. Rest them.
medical.returningSub: playable, but a rushed return risks a breakdown · one man a week can be wrapped in cotton wool
medical.onFumesSub: condition under 62% - it costs a starter; off the bench he still comes on at 60%
